```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class ExpenseFormComponent extends Component
{
    public $expense = [];
    public $title;
    public $amount;

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.expense-form-component');
    }

    public function store()
    {
        $this->validate([
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'amount' => 'required|numeric'
        ]);

        $expense = [
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'title' => $this->title,
            'amount' => $this->amount
        ];

        // Store the expense in your database or other storage mechanism

        session()->flash('success', 'Expense added successfully');

        return redirect()->route('expenses.index');
    }

    public function destroy($id)
    {
        // Implement logic to delete the expense from your database

        session()->flash('success', 'Expense deleted successfully');

        return redirect()->route('expenses.index');
    }
}
```
